section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains the connection between the level of "Eisan" and Rashbi, who achieved ultimate unity with G-d, and how even his study of the revealed Torah was a drawing down of Divinity.
section.t: And the explanation of the matter
(the connection of the aspect of Eisan to Rashbi),
it is known,
that Eisan refers to the essence of the soul,
the aspect of Yechidah,
which is united with Divinity in ultimate unity.
And this is the connection of Eisan to Rashbi,
for Rashbi was in ultimate unity,
as he said of himself, "I am merely a sign,"
"I am bound to Him, to the Holy One, blessed be He, with a single bond,"
"I am attached to Him, I am absorbed in Him, I am cleaved to Him"
[as explained in the notes of my master, my father,
the matter of the three expressions],
which is the nullification and unity that comes from the aspect of Yechidah.
And this is also that Rashbi was the source of the inner dimension of the Torah,
the secrets of the Torah, which are the soul of the Torah,
and the secrets of secrets, which are the soul of the soul,
for within the soul of the soul, the aspect of Yechidah is also included.
Moreover, even his study of the revealed [Torah]
(in which most of his study consisted),
was in the manner of the study of the inner dimension of the Torah,
a drawing down of Divinity from above to below.
For the difference between the revealed dimension of the Torah and the inner dimension of the Torah is,
that the revealed dimension of the Torah is clothed in physical matters in order to refine sparks,
but the inner dimension of the Torah is above clothing,
and the study of the inner dimension of the Torah is
(primarily not in order to refine sparks,
but rather)
to draw down supernal lights.
And by Rashbi,
even in his study of the revealed, the inner dimension shone,
to the point that even his study of the revealed was a drawing down of Divinity from above.
And this is the superiority of Rashbi over the other Tannaim,
for all the Tannaim,
their main occupation was either in the revealed dimension of the Torah or in the hidden dimension of the Torah.
For most of the Tannaim,
their main occupation was in the revealed dimension of the Torah,
for the masters of Kabbalah were few,
and "Rav Yehudah—all his teaching was in [the tractate] Nezikin,"
for this part of the Torah is clothed in the most lowly matters of this physical world itself
(matters of damages,
claims of falsehood, etc.),
in order to also refine the sparks within these matters.
And those whose main occupation was in the hidden dimension of the Torah,
the Work of the Chariot,
did not occupy themselves so much with the revealed.
Like Rabbi Nechunyah ben HaKaneh, who authored the book HaKaneh,
behold, in the revealed dimension of the Torah, only a little is brought from him.
But Rashbi,
in addition to the fact that his engagement in the inner dimension of the Torah was in a far more elevated manner,
drew the light of the inner dimension also into the revealed,
as is known
regarding the matter of "I wounded and I will heal,"
that through Rashbi, the partition between the revealed dimension of the Torah and the hidden dimension of the Torah was healed and nullified,
to the point that the revealed and the hidden are one.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the superiority of Rashbi over all Tannaim is incomparable, and therefore, to arouse influence from him, they needed to praise him.
section.t: And based on this, it will be understood that the superiority of Rashbi over all the Tannaim is an incomparable superiority,
therefore,
in order to arouse influence from him, they needed to praise him.
For the superiority of Yechidah over Nefesh-Ruach-Neshamah-Chayah is an incomparable superiority,
and this is also understood from the fact that it is called Yechidah, a term of singular,
for the title "singular" indicates that there is no second to it.
For although Yechidah is also
(a spark)
a created being,
and all five levels
(including Yechidah)
belong to the soul that is clothed in the body and in the manner of "name," as the statement,
"Five names are called to her"
(to the soul in the body),
nevertheless,
the essence of Yechidah is what it receives from the aspect of the Singular One,
a created spark whose essence is that within it is clothed a spark of the Creator.
And from this it is understood, all the more so, regarding the matter of the general Yechidah
(of the totality of the chain of descent, and all the more so)
of the Torah,
which is incomparably higher even than the soul of the Torah,
and certainly than the body of the Torah,
i.e., the laws of the Torah, which are called
"the bodies of the Torah."
Therefore,
in order to arouse the influence of Rashbi
(the aspect of Eisan,
Yechidah),
and particularly the inner dimension within this
(the concealment that is for its own sake),
so that it be drawn into the study of the Torah
(the revealed dimension of the Torah,
even into Nezikin)
of the Tannaim, whose study
was in the manner of clothing to refine sparks,
they needed to praise him,
for to arouse an incomparable influence, it is through the precedence of praises,
as mentioned above.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section questions how the praises of the Tannaim could affect Rashbi, and explains that it is because G-d desired a dwelling in the lower worlds, making the arousal from below effective.
section.t: But it needs to be understood,
since Rashbi was separated in value from the other Tannaim, how could their praises affect him, to the point of arousing and renewing influence to them?
And even more so, it is not understood regarding the matter of praises with which they praise the Creator,
in order to arouse the will to bestow to creations,
behold, the arousal of the will is in the Essence of Ein Sof, which is above the chain of descent
[as understood from what is explained in many places,
that through praises, they arouse the will to be drawn down and clothed in the Sefiros],
and how can it be that our praises take hold in the Essence of Ein Sof?
And the matter regarding this is known,
that this—that the raising of Mayin Nukvin of the creations
(including the matter of praises)
arouses the drawing down—
is because it so arose in His will, blessed be He, that the raising of Mayin Nukvin of the creations should take hold before Him, blessed be He.
Moreover, through the raising of Mayin Nukvin of the creations, there will be, as it were, a change in the light,
so that it be drawn down below to a place that is utterly incomparable,
even though from its own perspective, it is separate from this.
And one can say the explanation of this,
that since the Holy One, blessed be He, desired to have a dwelling place in the lower worlds,
the matter of "desired" is above reason, as the Alter Rebbe said,
"On a desire, there is no question,"
behold, since the desire and delight of the Above is a dwelling place in the lower worlds,
in a lower world beneath which there is no lower,
therefore, the raising of Mayin Nukvin of the creations affects the light.
And seemingly, one should add,
that this is also why the vast majority of praises
(in the order of praise of the Omnipresent in Pesukei DeZimrah before prayer)
are about His influence, blessed be He, upon creations,
for
[in addition to the fact that the praise must be of the same kind as the influence one wishes to arouse,
and in order to arouse influence below, the praises must be about this matter,
behold]
by praising before Him, blessed be He, His influence to the lower creations,
through this, they arouse and reveal the delight in a dwelling place in the lower worlds.
